F: sum of squared operator norm defects
proof: Let r_v=||psi_v||, m=mean(r), q=r-m. Scalar Poincare gives ||q||²<=E/4. w_v=sum incident delta_f² <=48, sum w=3F. Triangle telescoping gives sum w_v r_v²<=27E. Weighted triangle inequality yields sqrt(3F)m <= sqrt(27E)+sqrt(12E), so 3F m²<=75E. Then F||psi||²<= (600+F/4)E.
